title: Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Search Tree
goal: Solve Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Search Tree: Walk down: if both nodes are smaller go left, both larger go right; split point is the LCA.
strategy: Walk down: if both nodes are smaller go left, both larger go right; split point is the LCA.
edgeCases: If the current node equals either target, it can be the ancestor; otherwise use BST ordering to choose a side or the split point.
inputRules: p and q must be integers
